sections.name: summary
sections.value: Implement impl-guide units u1 and u2 in one serial Rust phase: preserve red controls, supersede only legacy taps, carry typed queue reasons, bound retries, and prove the live dev-daemon path.

value.title: Capture red controls and retry distinction
value.success: Pre-fix evidence proves legacy-tap refusal and the 12-hour versus cadence-scale queued-row distinction, with focused tests failing for each intended behavior.
value.notes: Use FlowSpace before meaning-shaped searches; retain exact RED output and do not change production daemons.
value.receipt: RED artifacts 64 and 70; read-only production SQLite row 926 diagnosis.

value.title: Supersede legacy taps and deduplicate refusals
value.success: The observer claims only legacy-generation pipes and logs a genuinely foreign unowned pipe once per pane per daemon boot.
value.notes: Legacy signature is pane_pipe=1, empty marker, and ~/.pij/pane-signals/_N.raw present; unknown foreign pipes remain untouched.
value.receipt: Narrow three-fact legacy signature; foreign pipe preserved; identical refusal surfaced once per pane/error per boot.

value.title: Carry reasoned tap deferral through delivery
value.success: Injection verdicts distinguish tap ownership from composer vetoes, queued receipts add reason tap-unowned, and the existing drain delivers after tap claim without another send.
value.notes: Wire stays v2; reason is additive and no legacy extension paths change.
value.receipt: Typed deferral enum, additive queued reason/next_retry_at, and one-send retry after tap claim.

value.title: Bound and expose vetoed socket retries
value.success: A human-typing/composer veto queues with reason human-typing, is re-evaluated within one cadence, delivers once when clear, and exposes queued reason plus next retry.
value.notes: First diagnose why one witness row lived 12 hours while others drained in minutes; preserve ledger dedupe and policy.
value.receipt: Configured cadence is shared by receipt schedule and drain loop; local witness row 926 retried 34 times in 169s.

value.title: Prove deterministic and live acceptance
value.success: Focused Rust tests, harness checks, foreign-pipe log count, and isolated dev-daemon real-client transcripts close AC1-AC6 without operator-home or production-daemon mutation.
value.notes: Production rs daemon is not restarted; legacy daemon stays running; live proof uses its own state dir and port.
value.receipt: assets/live-proof.md; Cargo artifact://142; final full harness checks green.

tk-1331.assertion: Every changed observable contract has a retained pre-fix failing witness, including the long-lived queued-row case.
tk-1331.receipt: Legacy refusal RED artifact://64; repeated-refusal RED artifact://70; production row 926 shows 34 attempts and 169s in the destination queue; the original receipt lacked reason/next_retry_at.

tk-1332.assertion: Tests distinguish legacy, owned, and foreign pipes; only the legacy pipe is superseded and repeated observer ticks emit one foreign refusal.
tk-1332.receipt: RED artifact://64 and artifact://70; GREEN pij-tmux adapter 33/33 artifact://68, focused supersede artifact://73, pij-daemon lib 153/153 artifact://79.

tk-1333.assertion: Tests prove typed veto reasons, additive queued receipt serialization, and queued-to-delivered transition after tap claim without a second send.
tk-1333.receipt: Reasoned receipt test artifact://75; tap-unowned queued-to-delivered transition artifact://93; workspace 586 passed artifact://88.

tk-1334.assertion: Tests prove reason human-typing, retry no later than one configured cadence after the veto clears, exactly-once delivery, and observable next-retry state.
tk-1334.receipt: Queued wire reason + next_retry_at and human-typing veto to next clear tick exactly-once tests passed artifact://96; workspace 586 passed artifact://88.

tk-1335.assertion: All focused and full gates pass and assets/live-proof.md contains the required control and isolated live transcripts with production daemons untouched.
tk-1335.receipt: Focused artifact://100; Cargo workspace/clippy/fmt artifact://142; harness checks all eight pass 2026-09-02T05:41:22.062Z; assets/live-proof.md.
